verdict.rationale: Radar's reviews API supports approve/decline actions on flagged payments and lets teams build custom review queues, which implies some decision logging, but there is no documented support for assignment to specific reviewers, escalation paths, or SLA tracking, and no explicit 'who approved what and why' audit trail beyond the approve/reject call itself. missing for 10: reviewer assignment, escalation workflow, SLA tracking, structured decision-rationale audit trail.
